title: What Is an Actor? 🎭
description: Understand the fundamental building block of Unreal Engine scenes.

slides.title: Everything Is an Actor 🎬
slides.content:
# The DNA of Your World

In Unreal Engine, almost everything you place in a level is an **Actor**. An Actor is any object that can be placed or spawned in a scene.

* **Static Mesh Actor** – a 3D model (chair, rock, building)
* **Light Actor** – illuminates the scene
* **Camera Actor** – a viewpoint
* **Player Start** – where the player spawns
* **Trigger Volume** – invisible box that fires events
* **Blueprint Actor** – custom actor with logic

*Analogy:* Actors are like **words in a sentence** – each one adds meaning. Together, they form your level's story.

quizData.question: Which of these is NOT an Actor type?
quizData.explanation: A texture file is an asset, not an Actor. Actors are objects placed in the world; textures are applied to them.

slides.title: Actor Components 🧩
slides.content:
## What Makes an Actor?

An Actor is a container that holds **Components**. Think of Components as the Actor’s organs:

* **Scene Component** – gives location, rotation, scale (root of actor)
* **Static Mesh Component** – renders a 3D model
* **Light Component** – emits light
* **Collision Component** – defines physical shape
* **Audio Component** – plays sound

A single Actor can have many Components. For example, a lamp Actor might have:
* Static Mesh Component (the lamp body)
* Light Component (the bulb)
* Audio Component (a humming sound)

quizData.question: What does a Static Mesh Component do?
quizData.explanation: The Static Mesh Component is responsible for displaying a 3D mesh in the world.

slides.title: The Root Component 🌳
slides.content:
## Every Actor Needs a Foundation

An Actor’s **Root Component** determines its position in the world. By default:
* The first component you add becomes the root.
* All other components are children of the root.
* Moving the root moves the entire Actor.

When you drag a Static Mesh into the viewport, Unreal automatically creates a Static Mesh Actor with that mesh as the root.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## The World Outliner Tells All

Open the World Outliner and look at the **Type** column. It shows exactly what kind of Actor each object is. Right‑click an Actor → **Edit** to see its Components in the Blueprint Editor.
